Vybe overnight HR/HRV/sleep would reach every Validic customer; Validic gains a screenless sleep band source.

Validic opening free developer self-signup out of Durham caught my eye, since we're building Vybe just down the road in Raleigh. Vybe is a screenless overnight band that reads heart rate, HRV and sleep timing and compares each night to the wearer's own baseline, with a developer SDK.

I'd like to know what it would take for Vybe to become a device source in Validic Inform, so your customers can get personal-baseline overnight data through the API they already use. Would you have 20 minutes? https://calendly.com/jeremy-vybe/30min
